boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Ohio Northern University
boards.description: A current, under-21-safe set of Ada and campus destinations with published late availability; confirm schedules before leaving, especially during breaks.

cards.title: ONU C-Store
cards.subtitle: Klondike Room, Ohio Northern University
cards.notes: Use the self-service campus store when other dining locations have closed; its reported 24-hour reopening makes it a practical late option.
cards.short_summary: A campus food stop with reported around-the-clock availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Northern Review reported that ONU's 24/7 C-Store reopened March 16, 2026 and described it as the campus dining-dollar location available 24 hours a day.
cards.source_title: C-Store set to open March 16 following closure — Northern Review
cards.access_notes: Reported to reopen March 16, 2026 as a 24/7 self-service location; verify current campus access and stock before going.

cards.entity_name: WOW Café American Grill and Wingery
cards.title: WOW Café American Grill and Wingery
cards.subtitle: Ohio Northern University
cards.notes: Check the meal-exchange window for a food option that officially extends to 11 p.m., rather than relying on daytime dining schedules.
cards.short_summary: ONU lists a late-night meal-exchange period through 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU Dining's FAQ says WOW meal exchanges run 7–11 p.m. Monday–Friday and 4–11 p.m. Saturday and Sunday.
cards.source_title: Ohio Northern University Dining Frequently Asked Questions
cards.access_notes: Published late-night meal-exchange hours end at 11 p.m.; hours and access may change during academic breaks.

cards.title: Polar Bear Food Cupboard
cards.subtitle: Chapel entrance nearest the pharmacy building, ONU
cards.notes: If food insecurity is the issue, use this no-questions-asked cupboard for available nonperishable food and personal-care items during the academic year.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour academic-year resource for ONU students who need food.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU says the Polar Bear Food Cupboard is accessible 24 hours a day during the academic year and students can take what they need without questions.
cards.source_title: Polar Bear Food Cupboard | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24 hours a day during the academic year; located in the Chapel entrance closest to the pharmacy building.

cards.title: Subway on South Main Street
cards.subtitle: 424 S Main St, Ada
cards.notes: Use the official location page to time a pickup or delivery order; it lists 10 p.m. closing every day of the week.
cards.short_summary: A daily 10 p.m. sandwich option on South Main Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway's official Ada location page lists store hours ending at 10 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Subway at 424 S Main St, Ada, OH
cards.access_notes: Officially listed daily hours are 8 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Saturday and 10 a.m.–10 p.m. Sunday.

cards.title: Cooper's Eateria
cards.subtitle: 105 S Main St, Ada
cards.notes: Plan a Tuesday–Saturday food run before the posted 10 p.m. close, and check the restaurant's own site for any schedule changes.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Ada eatery with published 10 p.m. Tuesday–Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Cooper's Eateria lists hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Tuesday through Saturday and 11 a.m.–8 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Published hours: Tuesday–Saturday 11 a.m.–10 p.m.; Sunday 11 a.m.–8 p.m.; closed Monday. The site says hours are subject to change.

cards.title: Ada Padrone's
cards.subtitle: 219 S Main St, Ada
cards.notes: Order ahead for pickup from this named Main Street pizza shop; the order page currently lists service until 8:30 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A Main Street pizza pickup option with an 8:30 p.m. listed close.
cards.evidence_claim: Ada Padrone's official ordering page lists its address at 219 S Main St and hours of 4–8:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The official order page lists 4–8:30 p.m.; place an order before closing and verify availability on the day.

cards.title: Viva Maria - Ada
cards.subtitle: 125 S Main St, Ada
cards.notes: Use the restaurant's direct ordering page for a carryout plan; it posts dinner service to 9 p.m. and carryout to 8:30 p.m.
cards.short_summary: An Italian-food stop with posted evening dine-in and carryout hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Viva Maria's official site lists Monday–Saturday business hours of 4–9 p.m. and carryout hours of 4–8:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are Monday–Saturday 4–9 p.m.; carryout ends at 8:30 p.m. Confirm operating status before travel.

cards.title: Drug and Health Information Center
cards.subtitle: ONU HealthWise, Ohio Northern University
cards.notes: For a late health-information question, call during the published evening window instead of treating it as an emergency care substitute.
cards.short_summary: A campus health-information service that publishes 10 p.m. weekday availability.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU HealthWise lists Drug and Health Information Center hours of 9 a.m.–10 p.m. Monday–Friday and 7–10 p.m. Sunday, with no charges for services.
cards.access_notes: Published hours are Monday–Friday 9 a.m.–10 p.m. and Sunday 7–10 p.m.; it is closed Saturday. This is not emergency care.

cards.entity_name: The Inn at Ohio Northern University 24-Hour Fitness Room
cards.title: The Inn at ONU 24-Hour Fitness Room
cards.subtitle: The Inn at Ohio Northern University, Ada
cards.notes: For guests staying at The Inn, use the listed 24-hour fitness room as an indoor late-evening activity; follow hotel access requirements.
cards.short_summary: A hotel guest amenity with stated 24-hour fitness-room access.
cards.evidence_claim: ONU's Summer Orientation page says all Inn room rates include access to the 24-hour fitness room.
cards.source_title: Summer Orientation and Welcome Weekend | Ohio Northern University
cards.access_notes: The 24-hour fitness room is described as included with Inn room rates; access is for hotel guests and may be subject to hotel rules.

cards.title: Old Route 69 Brewery Dining Room
cards.subtitle: 120 E Buckeye Ave, Ada
cards.notes: For an early-weekend meal, consult the restaurant's direct ordering page and use its published food-service schedule rather than bar hours.
cards.short_summary: A downtown dining room whose ordering page lists 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Old Route 69 Brewery's direct Toast ordering page lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11 a.m.–10 p.m. and identifies food service including sandwiches, burgers, salads, and pizza.
cards.access_notes: Published food-ordering hours run to 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday; choose food service and confirm current availability before going.

warnings: Several destinations have limited late hours rather than all-night service; verify same-day hours, academic-break schedules, and access requirements.
